Stack: React 18 + Vite + TypeScript + Tailwind + shadcn/ui. Never use `any` type. `@sentry/react` has just been installed via npm.

## Task: Sprint 7C — Sentry Error Tracking

### Read these files first:
- `src/main.tsx` — FULL file (entry point, needs Sentry init)
- `src/App.tsx` — FULL file (needs ErrorBoundary wrapper — read first 80 lines and last 30 lines)
- `vite.config.ts` — FULL file (for Sentry plugin consideration)
- `package.json` — verify @sentry/react is in dependencies

### 1. Initialize Sentry in main.tsx

**Modify `src/main.tsx`:**
- Add Sentry initialization BEFORE React rendering
- Use `import.meta.env.VITE_SENTRY_DSN` for the DSN (only init if DSN is set)
- Configuration:
  - `environment`: `import.meta.env.MODE` (development/production)
  - `tracesSampleRate`: 0.1 (10% of transactions)
  - `replaysSessionSampleRate`: 0.1 (10% of sessions)
  - `replaysOnErrorSampleRate`: 1.0 (100% of error sessions)
  - `enabled`: only when VITE_SENTRY_DSN is truthy (don't crash in dev without DSN)

### 2. Add Error Boundary to App

**Create `src/components/shared/ErrorFallback.tsx`:**
- A clean error fallback component:
  - Centered layout with AlertTriangle icon (red)
  - Title: "Something went wrong"
  - Subtitle: "An unexpected error occurred. Please try reloading the page."
  - "Reload Page" button that calls `window.location.reload()`
  - "Go to Dashboard" link as secondary action
  - Clean, minimal design matching existing ErrorState pattern
  - Include Sentry event ID display in small muted text (if available)

**Modify `src/App.tsx`:**
- Import `* as Sentry` from `@sentry/react`
- Import `ErrorFallback` component
- Wrap the outermost content (inside QueryClientProvider but around the Router) with:
  ```tsx
  <Sentry.ErrorBoundary fallback={({ error, eventId }) => (
    <ErrorFallback error={error} eventId={eventId} />
  )}>
    {/* existing Router content */}
  </Sentry.ErrorBoundary>
  ```
- Also wrap `Sentry.withProfiler(App)` on the default export (optional, for performance tracing)

### 3. Vite Config (optional Sentry plugin)

**Modify `vite.config.ts`:**
- Add a comment noting that `@sentry/vite-plugin` can be added for sourcemap upload when SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN is available
- Do NOT add the actual plugin (requires auth token and org/project setup) — just add the commented-out configuration:
```typescript
// Uncomment when Sentry org/project is configured:
// import { sentryVitePlugin } from "@sentry/vite-plugin";
// plugins: [
//   sentryVitePlugin({
//     org: "boldteq",
//     project: "convertscan",
//     authToken: process.env.SENTRY_AUTH_TOKEN,
//   }),
// ],
// build: { sourcemap: true },
```

### Requirements:
- No `any` types
- Sentry only initializes when VITE_SENTRY_DSN env var is set (graceful no-op in dev)
- ErrorFallback matches existing app design (Inter font, shadcn/ui Button)
- Don't break the existing app if Sentry package is missing or DSN is not set
- The ErrorBoundary should catch React rendering errors, not just fetch errors
- Keep it minimal — don't add Sentry.captureException calls throughout the codebase (the ErrorBoundary handles uncaught errors)
